LESSON: DRAWING AND PAINTING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Creating and Execution
Topic 1.2: Drawing and Painting
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Drawing and Painting, part of Creating and Execution in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to clean the brush after painting?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify materials for colour mixing

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Drawing and Painting in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. mix colours using spraying and blowing techniques,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Drawing and Painting in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. draw a simple picture using regular and irregular shapes,  Learners to watch videos to recognise how to mix colour by spraying and blowing technique. Learners with postural defects or short stature could be appropriately positioned for comfort and clear view. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Drawing and Painting together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Communication and collaboration: as the learner watch videos to recognise how to mix colour by spraying and blowing

technique,

 Creativity and imagination: as the learner explores colours mixing techniques in painting.

● Unity: is promoted as the learner cooperates with others as they perform pushing and pulling activities.

● Respect: is nurtured as the learner portrays positive regard for self and others as they practise pushing and pulling
